basics.name: deploymentId
basics.label: Deployment identifier
basics.toolTip: Used for resource naming and the cluster DNS prefix.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 1-54 letters, digits or hyphens. Start and end with a letter or digit.

elements.name: virtualNetworkId
elements.label: Existing virtual network resource ID
elements.toolTip: Full resource ID of the existing virtual network. Both subnets must belong to this network. Its address space must not overlap the cluster pod range 10.244.0.0/16 or service range 10.1.0.0/16.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a full virtual network resource ID: /subscriptions/<subscription-id>/resourceGroups/<group>/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/<network>.

elements.name: apiServerSubnetId
elements.label: Existing API server subnet resource ID
elements.toolTip: Full resource ID of a subnet in the specified virtual network, delegated to Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters for API Server VNet Integration.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a full subnet resource ID ending in /virtualNetworks/<network>/subnets/<subnet>.

elements.name: systemNodepoolSubnetId
elements.label: Existing system node subnet resource ID
elements.toolTip: Full resource ID of the system-node subnet in the specified virtual network. Routes must support load-balancer egress, not forced tunneling through a firewall.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a full subnet resource ID ending in /virtualNetworks/<network>/subnets/<subnet>.

elements.name: networkResourceGroupName
elements.label: Network resource group name (optional)
elements.toolTip: Existing group for private DNS and the optional Istio public IP, in the virtual network's subscription. Empty uses the deployment resource group name.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave empty or use 1-90 letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, periods or parentheses. Cannot end with a period.

elements.name: clusterEndpointType
elements.label: Kubernetes API endpoint
elements.toolTip: API Server VNet Integration remains enabled for either endpoint type.

elements.name: clusterIngressType
elements.label: Cluster ingress endpoint
elements.toolTip: Public enables the external Istio gateway and creates a public IP. Private enables the internal gateway instead. Binding the external gateway to the created public IP requires separate Kubernetes service configuration.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave empty or use 1-80 letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens. Start with a letter or digit and end with a letter, digit or underscore.

elements.name: availabilityZones
elements.label: Availability zones
elements.toolTip: Comma-separated supported zones in ascending order, without spaces. The initial system pool has three Standard_D4ds_v6 nodes. Confirm zone and VM availability in the selected region.

constraints.validationMessage: Use 1, 2, 3, 1,2, 1,3, 2,3 or 1,2,3, without spaces or duplicate zones.

elements.name: kubernetesVersion
elements.label: Kubernetes version
elements.toolTip: The version and the template's Istio revision asm-1-30 must be supported in the selected region.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a Kubernetes version such as 1.35 or 1.35.1.
Leave empty or use 1-63 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Start and end with a letter or digit.

elements.name: nodeResourceGroupName
elements.label: Node resource group name (optional)
elements.toolTip: Must not already exist. Empty uses <deployment-resource-group>-aks-nodes.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave empty or use 1-90 letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, periods or parentheses. Cannot end with a period.
Leave empty or use 3-128 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Start with a letter or digit.

elements.name: registryName
elements.label: Container Registry name (optional)
elements.toolTip: Must be globally unique. Empty generates a deterministic name from the resource group and deployment identifier.

constraints.validationMessage: Leave empty or use 5-50 letters and digits.

elements.name: lovableVersion
elements.label: Lovable version
elements.toolTip: Value of the unlabeled lovableVersion key in App Configuration.

elements.name: bootstrapToken
elements.toolTip: Stored in the bootstrapToken secret in Key Vault.

elements.name: serviceKey
elements.toolTip: Paste the base64-encoded service-account key. Stored unchanged in the GAR-serviceKey secret in Key Vault.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a nonempty, single-line base64-encoded key, including any required padding.

elements.name: bootstrapArtifactsBaseUri
elements.label: Bootstrap artifacts base URI
elements.toolTip: Public HTTPS directory containing bootstrap.ps1, application.yaml and appconfiguration.yaml. Do not include a trailing slash. Pin a commit-specific URI for reproducible deployments.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a public HTTPS base URI without a trailing slash, query string or fragment.
